What to Expect
at Wolwekrans
Award Winning Eco Self Catering Lodge in Mpumalanga
Wolwekrans Lodge, also known as the Jewel of Mpumalanga , is situated in the majestic Schoemanskloof escarpment, and features breathtaking 240 degree panoramic views of the Lowveld Valley and the Drakensberg Mountains with a beautiful outdoor swimming pool.
Wolwekrans is situated on a stunning 120-hectare mountainous farm and is even wheelchair friendly.
Absolutely perfect for romantic and family getaways in Mpumalanga.
Every Chalet has its own private boma, hot tub, look out deck, a fully equipped kitchen, and braai facilities . And best of all is that each chalet is 100% eco-friendly with electricity supplied via solar and gas.
We have the following unfenced wild game at Wolwekrans – Koedoe, Rietbuck, Duiker, Nyala, Bushbuck, Klipspringer, Bushpigs, Warthog, Jackal, Baboons, and some local Leopards.
We offer 2, 4, 6 sleeper self catering accommodation chalets.
There is a reason why we have been voted one of the best eco self catering lodges in Mpumalanga with new wood fired hot tubs.
Our promise to you is that you will leave Wolwekrans with a heavy heart after staying with us. At our lodge you will experience unforgettable eco self catering accommodation with a blend of untouched nature.
We are Proudly part of the Schoemanskloof Tourism & Accommodation Consortium. . Wolwekrans owner is PAJ Schoeman.
We are TripAdvisor Recommended as one of the Premier Self Catering Lodges and Accommodation Establishments in Schoemanskloof, Mpumalanga for a reason.
Need some more convincing? View our photos and read more information about our stunning self catering chalets.
